name: The Tetris Killer
source:
Five bodies were found by the police. They were heavily distorted and mummified to shape five of the seven Tetris pieces. 

You are the first reporter at the scene. Although you couldn't get inside the house, you've talked with one of the neighbors. It is bad, but it might also be the opportunity you've been waiting for, a chance to redeem yourself.

[From [url=https://nicosaraintaris.itch.io/the-tetris-killer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
警方發現了五具屍體。它們遭到嚴重扭曲，被製成乾屍，分別擺成了俄羅斯方塊七種形狀中的五種。

你是第一個抵達現場的記者。雖然沒能進入屋內，卻與一位鄰居交談過。情況很糟，但這也可能是你一直等待的機會，一個挽回自己的機會。

[摘自[url=https://nicosaraintaris.itch.io/the-tetris-killer]itch.io[/url]]
